svg.aria-label: Proposed design method. Six stages left to right: requirements with a verification matrix; items and interface control documents signed by both sides, with a generated N-squared design structure matrix; change requests with targeted impact, states and effectivity; about three parallel AI teams working from frozen interfaces in their own worktrees and returning structured proposals; a serial integration gate running a conflict scan, plm status, executable interface checks, BOM and parity checks, ERC/DRC and the verification matrix; and baseline tags with manifests and as-built records. Failed checks go back to the team; bench results on built pods raise new change requests. Each stage lists what exists today and what is missing. Below, four lanes give the roles of the owner, the lead AI, the AI teams and the automated checks.
svg.text: Proposed design method: requirements → interfaces → change → teams → gate → baseline
FOSS only, git-native, no servers. Each stage lists what exists today (green) and what is missing (red). Status 2026-10-01.
lead runs it · one at a time
check fails → back to that team
bench result on an as-built pod, or a new need → new ECR (effectivity: rework or rev 2)
• approves ECRs that touch her decisions
• signs any ICD that touches an O-item
• places and pays every JLC order
• builds and reworks by hand (rework notes)
• owns the bus items: REG-BOARD, REG-POD-BODY,
MCU pin map, rail/mass/volume budgets, frame.py
• regenerates N²/DSM; freezes and tags ICDs
• runs the gate, one proposal at a time
• signs the ICD side that has no live team
AI design teams (~3, from DSM clusters)
• write only their own items; read everything
• start from frozen ICDs, one worktree each
• return files, not chat: patch + proposal
• built from: SKiDL erc_assert, pcbnew, build123d,
Details, ranked improvements and sources: docs/research/methodology.md (2026-10-01). Rule set it extends: docs/system/README.md. Tracker: tools/plm.py.
